<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|“Congratulations on passing the second round!” The warm voice said from within the rainbow light.}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|— ''Uncrowned'', chapter 15}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Ninecloud Soul Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Ninecloud]] Soul is an entity that serves as an announcer and presenter during major events held within the arena. Utilizing a voice accompanied by flashing rainbow lights, this figure introduces various contestants, such as candidates for the [[Uncrowned]] and members of different warbands or teams, including the [[Akura backup team]] and the [[The Eight-Man Empire|Eight-Man Empire]] teams. The [[Ninecloud]] Soul also declares match victories, provides commentary on battle scenes through midair projections, and facilitates formal ceremonies. While the entity's tone can occasionally appear condescending toward certain cults, its actions are conducted in a manner that avoids offending the [[Ninecloud Court]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|This feminine spirit manifests as a beam of [[rainbow light]]. The entity is also described as a beautiful voice that emits [[rainbow light]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Ninecloud]] Soul serves as a professional announcer for the [[Ninecloud Court]] and is described as being quite busy. While the spirit reacts excitedly to certain actions, it has also shown anger toward [[Lindon]] by locking him in.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Ninecloud]] Soul interacts with [[Lindon]] by shouting his name, referring to him as number eleven, and congratulating him. This spirit also refers to [[Yerin]] as number ten, reacts to her actions, and announces her victory. Additionally, the [[Ninecloud]] Soul has announced victories for [[Akura Mercy]], [[Yan Shoumei]], and [[Eithan]], and may deliver items to [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The entity communicates using [[rainbow madra]] and produces floating models. As the voice of the [[Ninecloud Court]], it coordinates every [[construct]], announces tournament results and participants, and delivers information and prizes to competitors.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|Ninecloud Court announcer}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|The [[Ninecloud]] Soul serves as the professional voice of the [[Ninecloud Court]], acting as an announcer for the arena participants, teams, and cults.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c9">''Uncrowned'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c10">''Uncrowned'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c11">''Uncrowned'', chapter 11</ref> This feminine spirit communicates through [[rainbow light]] and [[madra]] to deliver information, prizes, and floating models to the competitors.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c12">''Uncrowned'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c13">''Uncrowned'', chapter 13</ref> During the tournament, the entity used its beautiful voice to shout [[Lindon]]'s name and display his image multiple times while referring to him as number eleven.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c12" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c17">''Uncrowned'', chapter 17</ref> The Soul also identified [[Yerin]] as number ten and reacted with excitement to her actions before announcing her victory.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c12" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c17" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c18">''Uncrowned'', chapter 18</ref> Beyond announcing fight results and the number of remaining competitors, the announcer provides entertainment by replaying match highlights.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c16">''Uncrowned'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c19">''Uncrowned'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c21">''Uncrowned'', chapter 21</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Wintersteel tournament}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The [[Ninecloud]] Soul serves as a public announcer, declaring victories and calling out the names of fighters within the arena.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3">''Wintersteel'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c5">''Wintersteel'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c6">''Wintersteel'', chapter 6</ref> During the proceedings, this entity introduces candidates for the [[Uncrowned]] and celebrates the accomplishments of [[Eithan]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c7">''Wintersteel'', chapter 7</ref> While coordinating every [[construct]] in the [[Ninecloud Court]] and occasionally bringing items to [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]]'s room, the [[Ninecloud]] Soul announces [[Akura Mercy]]'s victory and replays highlights from her three fights.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c9">''Wintersteel'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c15">''Wintersteel'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c16">''Wintersteel'', chapter 16</ref> Manifesting as a beam of [[rainbow light]], the entity expresses anger toward [[Lindon]] by having him locked in.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c17">''Wintersteel'', chapter 17</ref> The [[Ninecloud]] Soul also announces the prizes for the fighters and uses its voice to name the eighteenth [[Uncrowned King]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c23">''Wintersteel'', chapter 23</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26">''Wintersteel'', chapter 26</ref> Despite being described as quite busy, the entity's voice was not heard by [[Yerin]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c25">''Wintersteel'', chapter 25</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28">''Wintersteel'', chapter 28</ref>}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|and the Ninecloud Soul's voice spoke from all around them: “Representing the Monarch Akura Malice, the Akura prime team presents Akura Mercy, the favored daughter of the Monarch herself.”<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c10" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|“Congratulations on passing the second round!” The warm voice said from within the rainbow light.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|“What's this?” the Ninecloud Soul cried excitedly.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c17" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|“Sixteen competitors remain,” the Ninecloud Soul announced to a roaring crowd.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c19" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The roof of shadow madra split enough to allow her to hear the Ninecloud Soul declare, “Victory!”<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c5" />}}
